title: Define each feature as the smallest independently-verifiable slice of one wagon's behavior

facts.note: Planner artifact classified as a feature definition (by path/kind of planning artifact).

Write/edit of a feature artifact is visible from the tool call; read covers inspecting an existing feature during review. The tool call alone does not tell whether an edit is a split, merge or rescope.
Task text mentions defining, editing or reviewing features.

values: feature facet (urn, status, acceptance section, wagon link, feedback loop, size) changed
facts.note: Classifying an edit as a semantic split/merge/rescope, or judging whether a feature is the smallest independently-verifiable slice, is a semantic judgement; no detector binds this advisory anchor.

fires: Planner creates a new feature for a wagon.
Planner splits, merges or rescopes an existing feature.
Planner edits any facet of a feature (URN, status, acceptance section, wagon link, feedback loop, size) even when its boundaries stay unchanged.
Planner edits acceptance content in a way that could leave the feature's acceptance section empty.
Planner or reviewer checks an existing or proposed feature against the meaning of 'feature'.
doesNotFire: Editing wagon-level or train-level artifacts that do not create, change or review a feature.
Coder implementing production code for an already-defined feature.

given: A planner is authoring, editing or reviewing a feature within a wagon
when: the feature's scope, boundaries or any of its facets (shape, wagon link, feedback loop, size) are written, changed or checked
then: Keep the feature the smallest independently-verifiable slice of exactly one wagon's behavior: a bounded capability that is well-shaped, wagon-linked, feedback-closing and size-bounded.
prefer: Declare a URN, a status and a non-empty acceptance section on every feature (planner.feature.shape).
Link each feature to exactly one wagon (planner.feature.wagon-link).
Make the feature close the feedback loop it opens (planner.feature.feedback-loop-close-the-loop).
Keep the feature within the hard limits and the size-max rule (planner.feature.hard-limits, planner.feature.size-max-rule).
avoid: Features that cannot be verified on their own or bundle several capabilities.
Features shared across wagons or with no wagon.
Features with an empty acceptance section, missing URN or missing status.
Features that open a loop without closing it, or exceed size limits.
why: A stable meaning of 'feature' keeps planning slices independently verifiable and bounded; this node is an advisory semantic anchor that enforces nothing directly — its enforceable parts live in the constraint/rule nodes that require it.
evidence: No validator is bound to this node; compliance is established transitively by passing planner.feature.shape, planner.feature.wagon-link, planner.feature.feedback-loop-close-the-loop, planner.feature.hard-limits and planner.feature.size-max-rule.
Reviewer judges that the feature is a single, independently-verifiable, bounded capability of its wagon.
verifier_detail: Advisory semantic anchor (non-enforcing disposition): a definitional node that gives the artifact a stable meaning but is not itself bound to a validator; it is transitively protected by the enforceable constraint/rule nodes that require it. Do not emit findings from this node directly.

Facet map: feature -> {well-shaped, wagon-linked, feedback-closing, size-bounded}. well-shaped = declares a urn, a status, and a non-empty acceptance section (see planner.feature.shape); wagon-linked = belongs to exactly one wagon (see planner.feature.wagon-link); feedback-closing = closes the loop it opens (see planner.feature.feedback-loop-close-the-loop); size-bounded = respects hard limits and the size-max rule (see planner.feature.hard-limits, planner.feature.size-max-rule).
audit: source kind: family (rewritten as kind rule for this structure)
source name: 'Feature — advisory semantic anchor' (disposition: advisory, non-enforcing)
terms[0]: term_id semantic_anchor, label 'Advisory semantic anchor'

additions.text: Avoid list items phrased as negations of the facets.
